title: Code and derived data for: Promoting long-term carbon durability in fire-prone forests requires reducing stocks
description: Statistical matching and staggered difference-in-differences pipeline (stages 1 to 10) estimating carbon additionality and durability of protected areas, forest offsets, wildfire, and forest thinning in California forests, 1985 to 2025, at 30 m resolution. Includes input tables, data-derived decisions, matching balance, and all ATT estimates. Version 2.0.0 reproduces the revised manuscript submitted to Global Change Biology.
